title: Meta glasses banned from courts in England and Wales

paragraphs.en: Courts in England and Wales have joined a number of restaurants, theatres and pubs in banning Meta glasses, amid a mounting backlash against what has been described as “spyware”.
paragraphs.zh: 英格兰和威尔士的法院加入了众多餐厅、剧院和酒吧的行列，禁止使用 Meta 眼镜，因为这种被形容为“间谍软件”的设备正遭到越来越多的抵制。

paragraphs.en: Last month courts in New York announced a ban on the controversial glasses, which can record video footage while being worn.
paragraphs.zh: 上个月，纽约的法院宣布禁止这种有争议的眼镜，它在佩戴时可以录制视频。

paragraphs.en: Now His Majesty’s Courts & Tribunals Service (HMCTS), which is responsible for all criminal, civil and family courts in England and Wales, has made clear that Meta glasses will be confiscated from anyone entering its judicial buildings.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，负责英格兰和威尔士所有刑事、民事和家事法院的皇家法院与裁判所事务署（HMCTS）明确表示，任何进入其司法大楼的人携带的 Meta 眼镜都将被没收。

paragraphs.en: A spokesperson told the Guardian: “There are clear restrictions on taking images or videos within courts and tribunals which is why the use of Meta glasses is prohibited.”
paragraphs.zh: 一位发言人对《卫报》表示：“在法院和裁判所内拍摄图像或视频有明确的限制，这就是禁止使用 Meta 眼镜的原因。”

paragraphs.en: Taking images or videos in court buildings is prohibited in the UK without official permission and can be prosecuted as contempt of court. While lawyers and members of the public are allowed to enter courts with smartphones, which can record both video and audio, the
paragraphs.zh: 在英国，未经官方许可在法院大楼内拍照或录像属于违法行为，可被以藐视法庭罪起诉。尽管律师和公众可以携带既能录像又能录音的智能手机进入法院，但

paragraphs.en: HMCTS made clear that no such exception would be made for smart glasses.
paragraphs.zh: HMCTS 明确表示，智能眼镜不会获得任何此类豁免。

paragraphs.en: A source said: “Users who bring Meta glasses into courts or tribunals will have them confiscated on entry and they will be returned when the owner leaves the building.”
paragraphs.zh: 一位消息人士说：“将 Meta 眼镜带入法院或裁判所的用户，入场时会被没收，待其离开大楼时归还。”

paragraphs.en: They said smartphones were allowed on the condition they would not be used for recording court procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 他们说，智能手机是允许携带的，前提是不得用于录制法庭程序。
